//: Merge these into the 'hooks' section of ~/.claude/settings.json. They pull the memory base when a Claude Code session starts and push your new knowledge when it ends. Windows version shown; for macOS/Linux replace the command with: git -C ~/claude-memory pull --rebase --autostash --quiet  (and the matching add/commit/push line).

hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command 'Set-Location "$env:USERPROFILE/claude-memory"; git add -A .; if (git status --porcelain) { git commit -q -m "memory: auto"; git pull -q --rebase --autostash; git push -q }'
